title: Incoming call
summary: Rings the phone for a DM call while the app runs, with the caller's name and photo. Answer joins the call (spec call), decline sends the MSC4310 decline. A ring that ends without an answer becomes a missed call.

callerName.description: Display name of the sender, for bipe_call_incoming_voice or bipe_call_incoming_video.

expiresAt.description: The end of the ring (test-vectors/calls/ringing.json ringReads expiresAt).

ring.effect: Client.registerNotificationHandler gives a NotificationItem whose raw event is a ring for the own user (ringReads ring true). The device shows this screen (iOS a full-screen cover, Android an activity with showWhenLocked and turnScreenOn), plays the ringtone and vibrates until expiresAt. A ring for a room whose call the own user is already in does not show.

answer.effect: bipe_call_answer: stops the ringtone and joins the call of the room with the video flag of the ring (spec call join).

decline.effect: bipe_call_decline: stops the ringtone and calls Room.declineCall with ringEventId.

answeredElsewhere.effect: RoomInfo.activeRoomCallParticipants lists the own user (another device answered): the ringing stops and the screen closes with bipe_call_answered_elsewhere. No missed call.

timeout.effect: expiresAt passed, or the room has no call any more, and nobody answered on this device or another: the ringing stops, the screen closes, and the device posts the notification bipe_call_missed with the caller's name on channel bipe_call_channel_missed. The chat list preview of the chat shows bipe_call_missed.

notes: Group calls do not ring: notification_type notification gives a normal notification through the push rules (ringReads notify).

Ringtone: Android plays the ringtone of bipe_notifications_call_sound (the system ringtone picker in notification settings, default the phone's ringtone) through RingtoneManager with USAGE_NOTIFICATION_RINGTONE, and vibrates when the phone is on vibrate. iOS has no public API for the system ringtones: the app plays its own ring tone with AVAudioSession soloAmbient, so the silent switch mutes it, and vibrates. CallKit uses the system ringtone (bipe-chat/bipe#760).

Timeline (spec timeline-rows): an org.matrix.msc4075.rtc.notification item and the org.matrix.msc3401.call.member state events after it render as one call line: bipe_call_voice or bipe_call_video, bipe_call_missed, bipe_call_declined, or the duration bipe_call_duration, after the rule of test-vectors/calls/ringing.json lines. In a group, each member who joined gets bipe_call_joined. Membership events never show as raw state.
Locked phone and closed app: bipe-chat/bipe#760.
